messages: Lucy: Heads-up: quick microcopy + a11y review for the top-nav global shortcut. Current visible text: `Open Console — Ctrl+K`. We want to surface Mac users but keep the UI tidy. Options? Mike: Suggestion: `Open Console (Ctrl/Cmd+K)` — familiar pattern and compact. Ana: That looks fine but on narrow viewports the parent container truncates the trailing text. Users on mobile rarely see the inline shortcut. Jorge: From a dev perspective we render the shortcut span separate from the label, so we can hide it visually and move it into the tooltip without much work. However—screen readers will read DOM order; we should provide an expanded accessible string. Lucy: What about leaving visible label as `Open Console` only, and in the tooltip keep a short combo like `Shortcut: Ctrl/Cmd + K` and then a separate off-screen description `Press Control or Command and K to open the Console`? Mike: I like that split. Tooltip stays short for sighted users, SRs get a full sentence. Ana: Small copy nit: prefer spaces around the plus `Ctrl/Cmd + K` for clarity. For aria use full words (`Control`/`Command`) instead of abbreviations. Jorge: Implementation note: use `aria-describedby` targeting a visually-hidden element containing the full phrase. Avoid stuffing the aria-label with markup. If we need a link to the Keyboard Shortcuts page, surface it in the main menu, not the tiny tooltip. Design-Lead: Accessibility takes priority. Final recommendation: visible text `Open Console` (no shortcut), tooltip: `Shortcut: Ctrl/Cmd + K`, hidden sr text: `Press Control or Command and K to open the Console`. Also add the `aria-describedby` pattern to the component README. a11y-bot: a11y-bot check: Good. Use `Press Control or Command and K` in the screen-reader text. Ensure focus styles and role=button are present. Lucy: Draft tooltip string (short): `Shortcut: Ctrl/Cmd + K` Draft sr-only description: `Press Control or Command and K to open the Console` Mike: Approved. Also flag for localization: translators prefer full words in expanded text. Keep abbreviations in visual UI. Ana: One more tiny thing: If users customize shortcuts, tooltip should say "Default: Ctrl/Cmd + K". Do we support showing customized combos? Jorge: We don't have per-user quick shortcut sync yet. If we ever do, the tooltip can be dynamic. For now we should avoid implying it's configurable. Maybe `Default shortcut:` feels odd. I vote plain `Shortcut:`. Design-Lead: Final: Tooltip: `Shortcut: Ctrl/Cmd + K` SR text: `Press Control or Command and K to open the Console`. Lucy please update Figma and the docs with the `aria-describedby` snippet and an example code block for the README. Lucy: Will do. I'll add a code snippet: ``` Press Control or Command and K to open the Console ``` I'll also add a quick note: "Visual shortcut abbreviated; SR text uses full words for localization." Mike: Thanks 44d Can you link the README change here when it's live? Lucy: Yep, I'll paste the PR link once it's up.
